project_structure: HistoBIT3D_VirtualStaining/ 包含 README.md 和 HistoBIT3D_Code/。HistoBIT3D_Code/ 包含环境配置 (.envrc, requirements.txt, setup.py, conda_env.yaml)、脚本 (scripts/)、测试 (tests/)、核心库 (uvcgan2/) 和示例训练代码 (scripts/example_training/)。
architecture: input (BIT3D images) -> encoder (3D U-Net/ResNet backbone) -> feature extraction (style/content embeddings) -> style fusion module -> decoder (3D U-Net) -> output (HE stained virtual images)
